# dsh-deepseek-search-account
English | 中文
A tiny DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that keeps the built-in `web_search` and `web_fetch` tools work
ing when your chat model is served by an **external, non-official subscription** — for example **Ope
nCode Go** (`opencode.ai/zen/go`), another Anthropic-compatible gateway, or a pi-ai provider — while
DeepSeek Harness is signed in to a DeepSeek account.
Search and page fetching then run on the official DeepSeek **Search / Fetch API using that DeepSeek
account**, so both tools keep working without a `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`.
## When to use it / 适用情况
Use this plugin when **all** of the following are true:
- Your DSH chat model is served by a third-party subscription or gateway (OpenCode Go / Zen, another

Anthropic-compatible endpoint, pi-ai, etc.), not by a DeepSeek Account model.
- You are signed in t
o a DeepSeek account in DSH (Settings → Account), and that account may be used for search and fetchi

ng.
- The built-in web search fails with `DeepSeek search has no API key for "DEEPSEEK_API_KEY"`, an
d you do not have (or do not want to use) a DeepSeek API key.
In that situation the harness keeps working as before, but `web_search` returns an error. This plugi
n makes `web_search` use the official Search API and `web_fetch` the official Fetch API with the sig
ned-in account, so **search and fetching still run on the DeepSeek account's official quota** and th
e chat subscription is untouched.
Do **not** install it when:
- Your chat model is a DeepSeek Account model: the shipped provider already searches with the accoun

t sign-in.
- You have a `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` stored: the shipped provider already works (and the Searc

h API can be enabled in Plugins → Built-in plugin settings → Web search).
- You already use another
web-search provider plugin (Exa, Tavily, SearXNG, Zhipu, etc.) that suits you.
## Why it is needed
The shipped search providers (`dsh-web-search-deepseek`, `dsh-web-deepseek-api`) only use the DeepSe
ek account sign-in when the **initiating session's model route** is `deepseek-account`:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
With OpenCode Go as the chat provider, that check fails, the provider falls back to the `DEEPSEEK_AP
I_KEY` credential, and — with no key stored — `web_search` fails. This plugin resolves the same acco
unt token (`ctx.deepseekAccount.resolveToken(endpoint)`) on **every search and fetch**, without look
ing at the conversation's model route, and falls back to `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` (Bearer) only when accou
nt sign-in is unavailable.
## What it does
- Registers a search provider named `deepseek-account-search` and a fetch provider named `deepseek-a

ccount-fetch` on the `ctx.web` seam.
- Calls the official DeepSeek Search API (`POST https://api.dee
pseek.com/v1/tools/search`) by default — one HTTP request per search, about 0.5–1 second, returning

`title`, `url`, `snippet` and `date`; no auxiliary model turn, no extra model tokens.
- Calls the of
ficial DeepSeek Fetch API (`POST https://api.deepseek.com/v1/tools/fetch`) for `web_fetch` — one HTT

P request, the page body returned as Markdown, instead of the shipped anonymous `http` provider.
- F
alls back to the locally mounted `http` provider when the DeepSeek crawler cannot retrieve a page (H
TTP 403/404, raw text files, no extractable body), so `web_fetch` still works on those URLs; set `fa

llbackFetchProvider: none` to keep official fetching only.
- Keeps a legacy `mode: messages` search
backend (Anthropic-compatible Messages endpoint + the native `web_search_20250305` server tool) as a

n explicit fallback.
- Ships a bundle patch (`cordis.patch.yml`) that registers both providers and p
ins `web.searchProvider` / `web.fetchProvider` to them.

Then restart DSH (a profile bundle list change is applied on boot). For the Desktop app use the `des
ktop` profile as above.
### Manual install (file-path row)
If you prefer not to install a package, copy this folder somewhere stable and add two rows to the pr
ofile's `cordis.patch.yml` (`~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`):
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Keep `web_fetch` on the local anonymous transport and only move search? Pin `fetchProvider: http` in
stead — the plugin then leaves fetching alone.
Note: DSH reloads profile configuration live, but it does not re-import a plugin module when only th
e module path of an existing row changes. After editing `provider.js`, restart DSH — or toggle the r
ow `disabled: true` / back — to load the new code.
## Security
- The DeepSeek account token is read from the DSH credential service per request (`ctx.deepseekAccou
nt.resolveToken`) and sent only to the `api.deepseek.com` origin; the account service validates the

origin.
- The plugin never writes the token to disk and never exposes it to the browser.
- Fetches a
re performed by DeepSeek's server, so the target URL leaves your machine to the DeepSeek API rather
than being fetched locally. Only when the official fetch fails with a content error (403/404 or no b
ody) does the page get fetched locally through the shipped `http` provider; pin `fetchProvider: http

` or set `fallbackFetchProvider: none` if you never want local fetching.
- No runtime dependencies,
no install scripts: plain ESM using `node:` built-ins and the global `fetch`.
## Requirements
- DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.5` or later (the `ctx.web` seam and `deepseekAccount` service it relies

on).
- Signed in to DeepSeek in DSH, with network access to `api.deepseek.com`.
- Node.js 22+ (the
DSH desktop app bundles its own runtime).
